name: PointObjToHexagonCoorForPlot
comment: Returns one closed hexagon per point, stacked for an XY scatter. Argument order is xCoorArr, yCoorArr, diaArr. diaArr is the vertex-to-vertex diameter. The first vertex is at angle 0 on the positive x-axis, then every 60 degrees counterclockwise, so the hexagon is flat on the top and bottom. The first vertex is repeated to close the shape. An #N/A row separates hexagons. A non-numeric argument returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
